title: Finite scalar mates for qcqs compact support
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-qcqs-compact-support-finite-comparison, every positive finite scalar-adjunction mate of the completed proper/open compact-support image is invertible.

source.place: Finite comparison paragraph of the proper/open compact-support argument
source.note: Split from the parent conjunction; the proof uses the normalized quotient mate and proper/open factorization.

proof.text: Identify the completed and positive finite inverse-image coefficient identifications with those in SfCompleteDirectImageReduction. Their direct-image functors are the sf completed and finite functors. The ordinary restriction/direct-image comparison fixes every section, so after these identifications it is sfDirectImageRestrictionComparison.

Compare the two right-derived restriction/direct-image isomorphisms on K-injective representatives. Both satisfy the ordinary comparison square with the universal cochain units. Cancel the invertible finite direct-image unit and the exact restriction factor. Derived natural-transformation extensionality identifies the maps everywhere.

Use the normalized left-adjoint uniqueness square for the two scalar extension functors having the same exact restriction right adjoint. Its unit equation and the derived restriction comparison give the projection-formula transport cube with identity equivalence faces. Transport the existing sf_projection_formula from SfCompleteDirectImageReduction. This proves invertibility of the specified proper quotient mate for every ambient complex and every scheme morphism, without finite Tor or finite-field hypotheses.

Apply comparison_factorization. The proper factor at the completed open extension is invertible by the preceding argument. openComparison_isIso makes the second factor invertible, and proper direct image preserves this isomorphism. Their composite is exactly the required compact-support mate at each positive exponent. The use of openComparison_isIso is precisely [lem-pur-open-coefficient-comparison-isomorphism], not the whole integral coefficient comparison theorem. No assertion above the scalar projection identification is used.

proof_origin.place: P3: normalized ordinary and derived comparison identification; scalar-adjunction uniqueness transports the existing perfect-quotient projection formula; ordered proper/open factorization.
proof_origin.note: B3 dependency correction: the unchanged last Lean step uses openComparison_isIso, now attached to lem-pur-open-coefficient-comparison-isomorphism, rather than the whole integral coefficient comparison theorem. No Lean proof or statement changes.
